title: olearia tubuliflora
intro: Olearia tubuliflora, commonly known as the New Zealand tree daisy or bush daisy, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, soothing wounds, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Olearia tubuliflora include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
